spoken: StoreTryOn helps shoppers preview a shirt or jacket, then keep a shopping list, all in a SPECS Lens.
captions: StoreTryOn helps shoppers preview a shirt or jacket, then keep a shopping list, all in a SPECS Lens.

spoken: This walkthrough is Lens Studio's SPECS preview, using clearly labelled synthetic photos. I load the shopper photo once. The Lens reuses it for the rest of the visit.
captions: This walkthrough is Lens Studio’s SPECS preview, using clearly labelled synthetic photos. I load the shopper photo once. The Lens reuses it for the rest of the visit.

spoken: I select Shirt and load the garment photo. The review lets me inspect it before sending. Only Try it on starts an API request.
captions: I select Shirt and load the garment photo. The review lets me inspect it before sending. Only Try it on starts an API request.

spoken: That action sends both photos over H T T P S to the protected proxy, which keeps the You Cam key on the server. It uploads the images, creates a Clothes version four task, polls for completion, and downloads the result. The on screen stages reflect that work, with no fake percentage.
captions: That action sends both photos over HTTPS to the protected proxy, which keeps the YouCam key on the server. It uploads the images, creates a Clothes V4 task, polls for completion, and downloads the result. The on-screen stages reflect that work, with no fake percentage.

spoken: The returned image is a real You Cam result. I compare it with the garment, then add it to my shopping list. A second tap cannot save the same result twice.
captions: The returned image is a real YouCam result. I compare it with the garment, then add it to my shopping list. A second tap cannot save the same result twice.

spoken: Local storage keeps J peg thumbnails instead of expiring links. I open a saved item to see both photos. Clearing the list requires confirmation.
captions: Local storage keeps JPEG thumbnails instead of expiring links. I open a saved item to see both photos. Clearing the list requires confirmation.

spoken: You Cam A I Clothes version four uses upper body for shirts and outer for jackets, layering jackets over the existing outfit.
captions: YouCam AI Clothes V4 uses upper_body for shirts and outer for jackets, layering jackets over the existing outfit.

spoken: Capture, try on, save. Preview appearance. Check fit in store.
captions: Capture, try on, save. Preview appearance. Check fit in store.
